page.overview:
What is Uprising on Cloud City?

In 35 ABY, in the aftermath of the Battle of Exegol and the death of Darth Sidious, an uprising against the First Order took place on Cloud City, Bespin, as the destruction of Sidious' forces at the hands of the Resistance had inspired the inhabitants of the galaxy to rise up.
